title: Loads that are safe to run again
objectives: Say what makes a load idempotent
Replace a batch's rows by key instead of appending them again

exercises.prompt: The last run loaded orders 1 and 2 and then failed. Load the whole batch again so target has each order once, with the batch's values. End with SELECT order_id, amount FROM target ORDER BY order_id.
hints: Run the starter: orders 1 and 2 are in target twice now. What would a third run do?
First take out the rows this batch is about to load: DELETE FROM target WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM batch).
Then INSERT INTO target (order_id, amount) SELECT order_id, amount FROM batch. Name the columns (SQ010).
